nom: d'Alba Piedmont White Truffle Refresh Aqua Serum Spray

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin are among the most enthusiastic, reporting it keeps skin dewy and comfortable through dry winters, travel or hot climates, though one dry-skinned reviewer developed painful breakouts after using it.
segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin describe it as lightweight and non-greasy, giving a natural glow without adding shine.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin report no irritation or breakouts, though one who is sensitive to fragrance developed painful pimples on the side of her face where she sprayed it.
segments.mature: The reviewers who mention mature skin describe an instant glow and call it a good pick-me-up for their skin type.

concerns.dehydration: The core promise reviewers test; most report an immediate hydration boost and dewy finish that helps with tightness or dryness through the day, though several say the effect is short-lived or too subtle to justify the price.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer with dry skin developed several deep, painful pimples after use, and another mentions it breaks her out slightly with too-frequent use on acne-prone skin; many more reviewers explicitly report no breakouts even with daily use.
concerns.redness: A few reviewers report it calms redness and irritation on contact, including one with dehydrated, oilier skin.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin describe it as lighter than expected and effective for a quick shine reset without adding grease.

aspects.libelle: Very fine mist, some feels wasted before reaching skin
Works well as a midday makeup-setting refresh
More of a light refresh than a true moisturizer replacement

extraits.texte: This product smells great, but if you are sensitive to fragrance, beware! I really liked the moisture this provided to my face. I had some really dry skin on the left side of my face. Unfortunately, I developed several deep, painful pimples within a day or two of spraying it, specifically on that left hand side.

I was confused what this spray benefits actually were meant to be. Aside from making my face look shiny, I did not see anything else to brag about. Also, when I used this product, I didn't feel refreshed or cooled or tingly ... nothing.

This is such a nice and refreshing product. I can't wait to use in the summer. It leaves my skin looking dewy when I apply it at night and I think my makeup sits better the next day, looking hydrated. The mist is so fine and it has a nice light scent. A few things I wish were different - the mist is almost too fine, I feel like half of it dissipates before it reaches my face. I wish the spray were a bit more targeted so I doesn't feel like I'm wasting any product. Also I noticed some clogged pipes when I use this too many days in a row. I think it breaks me out a tiny bit. I will continue to finish up the product, just be careful if you have sensitive, acne prone skin.

I have skin that's dehydrated and on the oilier side and this White Truffle Refresh Aqua Serum Spray from d'Alba is great. It gives my skin a dewy look and absorbs easily. The smell is the only thing I wish were more floral but herbal is fine.

I like that this serum spray absorbs quickly and doesn't leave a sticky film. My skin feels lightly hydrated after using it, but I do still need a proper moisturizer layer. It does give a subtle glow, like a healthy, slightly dewy finish rather than that intense "glass skin" look people hype up. It works well as a midday refresh too!

I received the d'Alba White Truffle Refresh Aqua Serum as a gifted sample, and I'm honestly so impressed. I have mature skin, so hydration and glow are key for me, and this delivers. I've never tried a spray serum before, but the fine mist feels so refreshing and lightweight. I use it right after the shower, and it instantly makes my skin feel hydrated and plump while locking in moisture. It also gives the prettiest subtle glow ✨ I love using a few spritzes after makeup for that dewy, glass-skin finish. I've been pairing it with the Double Serum All-In-One Multi Balm Stick, and my skin has been feeling smooth, refreshed, and moisturized. Such an easy step that makes a big difference, definitely a new staple for me.

My favorite part of the D'Alba serum spray is the spray feature. So refreshing and immediately my skin felt cared for. Calmed any redness or irritation i might have had. Just tapped in targeted areas and let it do it's magic. Worked perfectly under makeup and with my skincare routine. Definitely recommend it for mature skin, great pick me up for use at any time.
